description: Land Acquisition - Heiyanthuduwa Biyagama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing four allotments of land to be acquired by the government for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their location, extent, current usage, and original claimants. The content primarily deals with land matters, specifically government acquisition of private property, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
